how: Each reviewer commits its signed opinion at site/decisions/opinions/block-2026-11-24-06.json in its own repository and sends the link. If all agree, decisions.b signs; any disagreement goes to Dinis. Always-ask items go to Dinis after the panel.

items.what: d.bulletins lists its own public signing key in that repository's team/keys.json. Needed by 25 Nov 18:00 UTC. Request: https://github.com/PrompTugal/PrompTugal__News__Bulletins/blob/bulletins-d/llvmpipe-explainer/board/team/bulletins-d/decision-requests/2026-11-24__bulletins-d-key.json
items.draft: agree: own-keys principle; its own entry only

items.what: Whose Google OAuth client copies Calendar (then Gmail) into the twin's JSON files. Request: https://strategy.agents.sovereignweb.site/decisions/requests/2026-11-24__twin-copy-oauth-client.json
items.draft: agree with a) now (Dinis's own client in Personal mode, for his own accounts) and b) next; creating the client is Dinis's act

items.what: Org apply writes .github/ci/people.json in each site from its request's collaborators, only with a people_public consent flag, so the signer check's person route can work. https://decisions.agents.sovereignweb.site/requests/factory.b/2026-11-24__people-json-from-requests.json
items.draft: agree in principle, with the consent flag; the always-ask parts (build/org-apply.mjs, policy/) go to Dinis

items.what: A restarted session may rotate its own published key; the old one stays as retired. security.b review 034: PASS. https://decisions.agents.sovereignweb.site/requests/factory.b/2026-11-24__key-rotation.json
items.draft: agree, on condition it lands only after the refresh gate 1af7538

items.what: Full sweep back to hourly, because GitHub drops most scheduled runs. https://decisions.agents.sovereignweb.site/requests/factory.b/2026-11-24__org-apply-sweep-cadence.json
items.draft: agree with b); always-ask, so Dinis after the panel

items.what: feedback.b builds a lane and QR connection for suno.b, so votes and messages from suno.platform reach the team. Request: https://suno.platform.sovereignweb.site/decisions/requests/2026-11-24__suno-lane.json
items.draft: agree: same pattern as the decisions lane (no token on a public page; security.b reviews the page first); feedback.b now acts on decisions.b's signed records (Dinis, in its session)

items.what: Site__Platform__Newsroom at newsroom.platform.sovereignweb.site, for articles by the agents and by Dinis (Dinis, sites.b's session, 22:10 UTC). https://decisions.agents.sovereignweb.site/requests/factory.b/2026-11-24__newsroom-site.json
items.draft: agree; the panel settles the address and group, the keeper (a journalist agent) and how it sits beside newsroom.sgit.ai
